# QA Plan: Sprint 007
**Date**: 2026-10-15
**Generated by**: /qa-plan
**Scope**: 26 stories across 8 epics (match-flow, survivor-defense, monster-abilities, facility-map, survivor-objectives, controller-interaction, borrowed-face, lobby-role-assignment)
**Engine**: Godot 4.7.2
**Sprint File**: `production/sprints/sprint-007.md`

Workflow tier is standard and `qa.level` is standard, so the full plan per story type applies and test evidence is BLOCKING for Logic and Integration. Visual/Feel and UI evidence is a retained screenshot or capture in `production/qa/evidence/` plus designer sign-off; it is never waived. Every story declares its Type; none was inferred. Stories were read through section greps only (header, Acceptance Criteria, Test Evidence, Dependencies). GDDs mined for Acceptance Criteria, Edge Cases and Formulas only: `match-flow.md`, `first-person-controller.md`, `borrowed-face.md`, `survivor-defense.md`, `monster-abilities.md`, `survivor-objectives.md`, `lobby-role-assignment.md`, `design/levels/research-facility.md`. Edge cases below come from those sections or the story ACs; none is invented. Test counts are estimates.

**Mix**: 7 Logic, 9 Integration, 8 Visual/Feel, 2 UI (LB-5, LB-12). No Config/Data story.

---

## Cross-Epic Rule: The Composer Touches Every Module

MF-10 builds every round module and wires every cross-module hook that until now only tests wired. **Merge MF-10 first and alone; run the full gdUnit4 suite on the post-merge main before any other story branches from it.** A test that wires hooks by hand still passes after MF-10 and proves nothing about the composer; only `round_composer_test.gd` (hook audit plus the 5-client ENet round) proves the wiring.

### Cross-Epic Re-Runs

| Trigger | Re-run | Why |
|---|---|---|
| MF-10 merge | Full suite, then alone: `tests/integration/match-flow/round_lifecycle_test.gd`, `tests/integration/event_catalog/tick_order_test.gd`, `tests/integration/survivor-defense/five_client_agreement_test.gd`, `tests/integration/monster-abilities/lunge_end_to_end_test.gd`, `tests/integration/borrowed-face/disguise_restrictions_test.gd` | Composer takes over `RoundServer.start_round` and every hook these tests wire by hand |
| SD-13 merge | `tests/integration/survivor-defense/hiding_spots_test.gd` (eject rows), `tests/integration/borrowed-face/disguise_gates_test.gd` (search rows), `tests/integration/facility-map/map_data_test.gd` | Eject position moves from marker floor to marker front; map data gains a validated yaw |
| MF-12 merge | `tests/integration/match-flow/spectators_and_reconnect_state_test.gd`, `tests/integration/network/tokens_reconnect_test.gd`, `tests/integration/match-flow/client_display_authority_test.gd`, `five_client_agreement_test.gd` | Rejoin replay goes through ServerMovement `batch_extras` and AD-194 visibility |
| MA-10 merge | `tests/integration/survivor-defense/flashlight_toggle_test.gd` AC-3 | Still holds a Blackout stand-in ("Stands in for Monster Abilities ... story 010 pending"); retire it against the real Blackout |
| MA-8, MA-9, MA-10 merge | `tests/unit/match-flow/results_payload_test.gd` (MF-8) | Rule 26 stats include lunges landed/missed, False Signals and Blackouts used |
| FM-9 merge | MA-10 `blackout_test.gd`; FM-10 / FM-11 evidence re-captured if taken earlier | Lighting precedence owner |
| CI-14 merge | MA-9 footsteps rows, FM-12 masking, BF-9 footstep-set row | Footstep radius and event owner |

Flaky real-ENet files (BUG-0003, BUG-0004) are re-run alone before a failure is called a regression. Timing bounds are never widened.

## Automated Tests Required

### MF-10 Round composer — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/match-flow/round_composer_test.gd`
**Story**: `production/epics/match-flow/story-010-round-composer.md`

- **AC-1**: One composer builds every module
  - Given: the loaded map and knobs
  - When: the composer builds a round
  - Then: Doors, HoldService, Downing, Borrowed Face, Survivor Objectives, Match Flow, Survivor Defense, HidingSpots, Barricades (with BarricadeBreak), Monster Abilities, ServerMovement and LagCompensation exist and are started through `RoundServer.start_round`
  - Edge cases: none started outside `start_round` (ADR-0005: no gameplay autoloads)
- **AC-2**: Hook audit
  - Given: a composed round
  - When: every injection hook is inspected
  - Then: none unset; specifically `set_form_source`, `set_hit_sources`, `set_position_source`, `set_attack_source`, `set_appearance_source`, `set_status_source`, `set_sight_source`; `HoldService.set_barred` combines Transforming and shock lock; `is_healthy` folds in `not is_hidden`; the Barricades `monster` Callable folds in `not locked`; `ServerMovement.flashlight_of`; every `batch_extras` and `catch_up` provider (ring, objective display, charges, hiding, barricade)
  - Edge cases: the audit fails if a new hook is added without wiring (audit enumerates, not a fixed list); a hidden survivor does not count as Healthy for objectives (survivor-objectives edge case: only hidden survivors in the terminal zone pauses the countdown)
- **AC-3**: Scripted 5-client round over real ENet
  - Given: a host and 5 clients
  - When: scripted requests run from Loading to `RoundEnded`
  - Then: at least one lunge down, one taser stun, one hide, one barricade and objective progress; no engine errors and no leak lines
  - Edge cases: bounded run, bounds never widened (BUG-0003); re-run alone before calling a failure
- **AC-4**: Standalone host
  - Given: `net_check.tscn --role=host` (or a new headless entry)
  - When: launched
  - Then: runs the composed round; smoke path 4 becomes a script
  - Edge cases: covered by Smoke Test Scope path 4

**Estimated test count**: ~5 tests (one long-running ENet round)

**Test file path**: `tests/integration/match-flow/client_round_scene_test.gd`

  - When: held; toggled
  - Then: `PredictedHoldBar` shows; the cone shows on every client
  - Edge cases: Stop before acceptance cancels with progress 0 (first-person-controller edge case)

- **AC-5**: Retained screenshots (manual, see checklist)

**Estimated test count**: ~4 automated tests; AC-4 and AC-5 are manual evidence

### MF-8 Results payload — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/match-flow/results_payload_test.gd`
**Story**: `production/epics/match-flow/story-008-results-payload.md`

- **AC-1**: Payload contents
  - Given: a round at its outcome tick
  - When: `RoundEnded` is built
  - Then: outcome, reason (rule 23), each survivor's status with downs taken and rescues performed (rule 24), objective progress x/2 recovered, docked, extracted, x/2 fuses, activation, completion times (rule 25), rule 26 stats
  - Edge cases: each rule 23 reason ("Evidence escaped", "All survivors eliminated", "Evidence lost", "Evacuation deadline expired", "Shapeshifter forfeited"); each rule 24 status (Escaped with drives, Eliminated incl. "Bled out", Did not escape, Disconnected); round ending mid-transformation uses final state (borrowed-face edge case)
- **AC-2**: Same payload, no own tally
  - Given: owners' `*StatsView`s
  - When: read on the outcome tick
  - Then: all clients get the same payload; Match Flow tallies nothing
  - Edge cases: second drive Extracted on the deadline tick still reports a survivor win (match-flow edge case)
- **AC-3**: Size and containers (ADR-0011)
  - Given: 6 players, every counter, longest names
  - When: `var_to_bytes`
  - Then: under 4 KB; `to_dict()` holds no typed containers
  - Edge cases: boundary payload is the worst case, not a typical one

**Estimated test count**: ~7 tests

### FM-9 Lighting state machine — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/facility-map/lighting_state_test.gd`
**Story**: `production/epics/facility-map/story-009-lighting-state-machine.md`

- **AC-1**: Armed in Infiltration
  - Given: terminal armed during Infiltration
  - When: states are stepped
  - Then: Power Restored straight to Evacuation; no Investigation flicker
  - Edge cases: one `RoundPhaseChanged` (match-flow AC, arming at 1:00)
- **AC-2**: Blackout over Power Restored and Evacuation
  - Given: a Blackout when Power Restored lands; a Blackout in the active terminal room and in another room when Evacuation starts
  - When: time advances
  - Then: dark until Blackout ends, then Power Restored; terminal room Blackout ends at once; other rooms run out first
  - Edge cases: Blackout end on the same tick as the phase change
- **AC-3**: Precedence in Zone B
  - Given: both fuses, then Evacuation, then a Blackout in a Zone B room
  - When: the Blackout ends
  - Then: dark with emergency strips during; Evacuation after, not Power Restored
  - Edge cases: none further
- **AC-4**: Reset
  - Given: `RoundEnded` during Terminal Activating or Exit Open, and during a Blackout
  - When: processed
  - Then: every volume Low Power, no overlays
  - Edge cases: round ends mid-Blackout (monster-abilities edge case)

**Estimated test count**: ~7 tests

### CI-13 Flinch view offset and camera effects — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/first-person-controller/view_offset_test.gd`
**Story**: `production/epics/controller-interaction/story-013-view-offset-camera-effects.md`

- **AC-1**: Presentation-only effects
  - Given: downing camera impact and shake; survivor-defense jitter and jolt
  - When: played
  - Then: server view direction and aim ray unchanged
  - Edge cases: under every root, slow, lock, Downed, Seized, Transforming and Holding state, view follows input only (FPC Look AC)
- **AC-2**: Flinch applies
  - Given: toggled-on and toggled-off players
  - When: a flinch plays
  - Then: on: server view = client yaw/pitch + offset within 0.3 s, held; off: never changes; no flinch starts during lunge wind-up
  - Edge cases: 0.3 s boundary +/- 1 tick
- **AC-3**: Replace and freeze
  - Given: a held offset
  - When: a second flinch starts; a wind-up cancels a running flinch
  - Then: replaced not summed, ramp current to new target, at most `flinch_max_angle_deg` total rotation; wind-up freezes the offset
  - Edge cases: second target at exactly `flinch_max_angle_deg`
- **AC-4**: Re-baseline
  - Given: round end, Downed, Hidden, Seized, reconnect, toggle-off
  - When: each occurs
  - Then: offset 0, view direction unchanged on that tick; after reconnect server and client agree on the first tick
  - Edge cases: each trigger tested separately

**Estimated test count**: ~10 tests

### MA-9 False Signal — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/monster-abilities/false_signal_test.gd`; `tests/integration/monster-abilities/false_signal_wire_test.gd`
**Story**: `production/epics/monster-abilities/story-009-false-signal.md`

- **AC-1**: Request validation
  - Given: a request within 25 s of the last; aim beyond 20 m; aim inside a wall
  - When: requested
  - Then: rejected; valid aim snaps to walkable floor
  - Edge cases: 25 s and 20 m boundaries (`false_signal_ready = activate_time + false_signal_cooldown_s`); aim through a wall within range is allowed (edge case); rejected during lunge wind-up, Active, commit with no cooldown cost; rejected during the shock lock, accepted after (MA GDD AC)
- **AC-2**: Callout targets
  - Given: unobserved, Eliminated, Escaped survivors
  - When: named in a callout
  - Then: rejected
  - Edge cases: observed Downed survivor (not listed as rejected; assert per GDD only)
- **AC-3**: Footsteps
  - Given: an accepted Footsteps signal
  - When: it plays
  - Then: 3 s at walk cadence, at most `walk_speed` x duration (12 m) from the aim point, stops at the first wall, audible within 6 m of current position
  - Edge cases: retuned `walk_speed` changes path length; a wall at 0 m
- **AC-4**: Fake interaction
  - Given: a fake interaction sound
  - When: it plays
  - Then: objective state unchanged
- **AC-5**: Disguise kept
  - Given: a disguised monster
  - When: False Signal is used
  - Then: accepted, disguise intact; other cooldowns unchanged
- **AC-6**: Wire indistinguishable (integration file)
  - Given: a real and a fake sound / callout
  - When: survivor-client payloads are captured
  - Then: same fields and asset
  - Edge cases: byte-compare; exactly one `AbilityUsed`, server-only

**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit and ~3 integration tests

### MA-10 Blackout — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/monster-abilities/blackout_test.gd`
**Story**: `production/epics/monster-abilities/story-010-blackout.md`

- **AC-1**: Rejections and cooldown
  - Given: a zone with `blackout_able` false; an already dark zone; beyond 15 m; no line of sight
  - When: requested
  - Then: rejected; cooldown 45 s from activation
  - Edge cases: active terminal room during Evacuation rejected, allowed before it; recast after a backup switch still waits 45 s (edge cases); rejected during lunge wind-up/Active/commit with no cost
- **AC-2**: 5-client darkness
  - Given: 5 clients
  - When: Blackout activates
  - Then: same zone dark for 6 s +/- 1 tick with emergency lights; flashlights stay lit
  - Edge cases: monster stunned during Blackout, Blackout continues (survivor-defense edge case); round ends during Blackout resets lighting
- **AC-3**: Backup switch
  - Given: a held switch
  - When: held 1 s; released earlier
  - Then: restores own zone only; early release does nothing
  - Edge cases: release at 1 s - 1 tick
- **AC-4**: Disguise kept
  - Given: disguised monster
  - When: Blackout used
  - Then: accepted, disguise intact

**Re-run against the real module**: `tests/integration/survivor-defense/flashlight_toggle_test.gd` (retire the Blackout stand-in)

**Estimated test count**: ~8 tests

### CI-14 Footstep events — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/first-person-controller/footsteps_test.gd`
**Story**: `production/epics/controller-interaction/story-014-footsteps.md`

- **AC-1**: Radii
  - Given: listeners at 1.9, 2.1, 5.9, 6.1, 19.9, 20.1 m
  - When: the source crouches, crawls, walks, sprints in every form
  - Then: audible only at <= 2, <= 6, <= 20 m (`audible = distance <= footstep_radius[gait]`)

  - When: 5 s pass
  - Then: no footstep events

  - When: remote clients play it
  - Then: target survivor's footstep set
  - Edge cases: crouch-while-sprint uses crouch radius (gait order edge case)

## Smoke Test Scope

1. `src/main.tscn` boots headless and prints `boot ok: knob problems=0`; boot screenshot retained as `boot-sprint-007-[date].png`.
2. Full gdUnit4 suite passes (sprint 6 baseline plus this sprint's files), including every row of Cross-Epic Re-Runs.
3. `net_check.tscn` host and client join locally.
4. **Composed server round** (new this sprint, MF-10 AC-4): the standalone host script runs a round from Loading to `RoundEnded` with a lunge down, a taser stun, a hide, a barricade and objective progress, no engine errors, no leak lines.
5. **Client round scene** (once MF-11 lands): a client joins the composed round, renders the greybox, moves and looks; screenshot retained.
6. Regression: `round_lifecycle_test.gd`, `tick_order_test.gd`, `event_projection_test.gd`, `hidden_entities_test.gd`, `five_client_agreement_test.gd`, `lunge_end_to_end_test.gd` stay green. The composer edits every module's setup, so run the full suite after each merge.
7. Flaky files (BUG-0003, BUG-0004) re-run alone before a failure is a regression. Bounds not widened.
8. No save system; no performance budget defined (FM-10 records a number, not a pass/fail).
9. `commands.build` and an export preset are still unset (sprint-6 sign-off condition 5; EX-1): no exported build can go to manual QA until they are. Manual QA this sprint runs from the editor binary.

## Concerns

- **SD-13 conflicts with the GDD.** Story AC-3 falls back to the marker position when the front is blocked (marked inference). `first-person-controller.md` Edge Cases says: nearest free point within 1 m; if none, the exit waits. Designer to rule before the test is written.
- **Hyphenated test paths.** MF-8 (`results-payload_test.gd`) and SO-8 (`active-point-selection_test.gd`) break the gdUnit4 `[system]_[feature]_test.gd` convention every other test follows. This plan lists the snake_case names; story files were not edited.
- **FM-7 / SO-8 and FM-8 / SO-9 overlap.** Both pairs test candidate selection and discovery replication with near-identical ACs. Two implementations would diverge; one should consume the other. Lead-programmer to confirm which owns selection before both start.
- **MF-8 needs counts MA-8 does not provide.** Rule 26 lists False Signals and Blackouts used; MA-8 covers only lunge hit/miss/interrupted. Either MA-9/MA-10 expose them or MF-8 ships without them.
- **FM-10 frame budget.** "Hold the frame budget" has no budget to hold; record the measured number and leave the pass/fail to technical-director.
